from pathlib import Path
programs=base/'programs'
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [[0 if v == 4 else v for v in row] for row in grid]
    barrier_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v != 4:
                continue
            nr = min(r + 1, h - 1)
            out[nr][c] = 4
            if nr + 1 in barrier_rows:
                d = 1
                while nr - d >= 0:
                    out[nr - d][c - d] = 4 if c - d >= 0 else out[nr - d][c - d]
                    if c + d < w:
                        out[nr - d][c + d] = 4
                    d += 1
    return out
'''
# simplify the potentially awkward left bound expression
code=code.replace("out[nr - d][c - d] = 4 if c - d >= 0 else out[nr - d][c - d]", "\n                    if c - d >= 0:\n                        out[nr - d][c - d] = 4")
p.write_text(code)
print(code)
